Stated ranges are flower eighths $18–$35, pre-rolls $5, concentrates $26–$35, 1g vapes $25 and chews $10–$15. It says these prices won't rise for at least 12 months and no strain is excluded from bundle pricing.

deals.title: Student discount: 10% off

deals.title: Pediatric patient discount: 25% off

deals.title: Senior 55+ discount: 10% off
